metadata.description: Pre-generated LLM briefings for 2023 McDougall Creek fire demo scenario
metadata.fire_conditions: Aug 17 2023, 7PM, wind 17.8 km/h E, spread rate EXTREME
metadata.notes: Keyed by profile flag string. 'default' is the baseline (no flags set). Regenerate with backend/scripts/generate_demo_briefings.py when LLM prompt changes.

briefings.default: Fire is 260 metres from your address and closing fast — evacuate now. Take Westlake Road south to Hwy 97 S and proceed to Royal LePage Place, 5.2 km, approximately 8 minutes. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
briefings.mobility: Fire is 260 metres from your address and closing fast — evacuate now. Take Westlake Road south to Hwy 97 S and proceed to Royal LePage Place — accessible entry confirmed, 5.2 km, approximately 8 minutes. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
briefings.medical: Fire is 260 metres from your address and closing fast — evacuate now. Take Westlake Road south to Hwy 97 S and proceed to Royal LePage Place, 5.2 km, approximately 8 minutes. This shelter has full electrical infrastructure for medical equipment. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
briefings.pets: Fire is 260 metres from your address and closing fast — evacuate now. Take Westlake Road south to Hwy 97 S and proceed to Royal LePage Place, 5.2 km, approximately 8 minutes. Recommended shelter accepts pets. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
briefings.no_vehicle: Fire is 260 metres from your address and closing fast — evacuate now. The recommended shelter is Royal LePage Place, 5.2 km south via Westlake Road and Hwy 97 S. If you need transportation assistance, call Emergency Support Services at 1-800-387-4258. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
